interpretation_qualification: The domain runs outward from Earth in this presentation.

title: Sixth Lecture — GA 110. Spiritual Hierarchies and their Reflection in the Physical World
paraphrase: The esoteric Mercury marks the extent of the Archangeloi domain.

paraphrase: The esoteric Venus marks the extent associated with the Archai.

title: Sixth Lecture — GA 110. Spiritual Hierarchies and their Reflection in the Physical World
paraphrase: The Sun marks the extent of the Spirits of Form, whose mission spans successive embodiments.
interpretation_qualification: A sphere boundary can coexist with participation by other hierarchies.

title: Sixth Lecture — GA 110. Spiritual Hierarchies and their Reflection in the Physical World
paraphrase: The Mars boundary is assigned to Spirits of Movement.
interpretation_qualification: Steiner uses nested regions of activity.

title: Sixth Lecture — GA 110. Spiritual Hierarchies and their Reflection in the Physical World
paraphrase: Jupiter marks the extent of the Spirits of Wisdom in the diagram.
interpretation_qualification: GA 136 gives Spirits of Wisdom a distinct role in general planetary constitution.

title: Sixth Lecture — GA 110. Spiritual Hierarchies and their Reflection in the Physical World
paraphrase: Saturn marks the extent of the Thrones in the hierarchy diagram.
interpretation_qualification: The reference is present Saturn as a spatial marker.

title: Planetary Spirits that Determine Destiny and Liberate Humanity I — GA 228. The Development of Human Consciousness
paraphrase: Saturn preserves and discloses the past of the planetary system.
interpretation_qualification: Read as Steiner’s description of spiritual perception.

title: Planetary Spirits that Determine Destiny and Liberate Humanity I — GA 228. The Development of Human Consciousness
paraphrase: Jupiter is described as the thinker of the planetary system, presenting the cosmic present in living ideas.
interpretation_qualification: The same lecture also associates Jupiter with the freedom to think.

title: Planetary Spirits that Determine Destiny and Liberate Humanity I — GA 228. The Development of Human Consciousness
paraphrase: Mars contributes to cosmic impulses for speech.
interpretation_qualification: GA 228 also brings Venus into the account of how speech comes about.

title: Planetary Spirits that Determine Destiny and Liberate Humanity I — GA 228. The Development of Human Consciousness
paraphrase: Venus is receptive to what lives in the depths of human souls and reflects it back.
interpretation_qualification: The context is the spiritual individuality of Venus.

title: Planetary Spirits that Determine Destiny and Liberate Humanity I — GA 228. The Development of Human Consciousness
paraphrase: Mercury works with Venus to deepen the soul-spiritual side of karma in disposition and temperament.
interpretation_qualification: Steiner distinguishes this from the Moon’s relation to heredity.

title: Planetary Spirits that Determine Destiny and Liberate Humanity I — GA 228. The Development of Human Consciousness
paraphrase: Steiner describes the Moon as the retreat of primeval teachers once active on Earth.
interpretation_qualification: The migration is part of his esoteric account.

title: Planetary Spirits that Determine Destiny and Liberate Humanity I — GA 228. The Development of Human Consciousness | Michael's Mission in the World Age of Human Freedom — GA 26. Anthroposophical Guiding Principles
paraphrase: GA 228 gives the Sun a mediating role between destiny-forming and freedom-enabling tendencies. GA 26 separately relates Christ to free human activity.
interpretation_qualification: The two lectures address different levels. This edge records the thematic connection.

title: Fourteenth Lecture — GA 204. Perspectives on Human Evolution
paraphrase: Steiner says that beings including those he calls Vulcan beings have begun approaching earthly development.
interpretation_qualification: The lecture gives no proof that they are the agents of the earlier Oracle or inhabitants of Future Vulcan.

title: Sixth Lecture — GA 110. Spiritual Hierarchies and their Reflection in the Physical World | IV. The Evolution of the Cosmos and Man — Occult Science (1972) | Third Lecture — GA 102. The Influence of Spiritual Beings on Man
paraphrase: Jupiter bounds the Spirits of Wisdom in GA 110, and GA 13 assigns those spirits Old Sun etheric formation. GA 102 gives Jupiter beings an etheric role in a separately worded Earth narrative.
interpretation_qualification: Shared connections warrant a route through the sources, with each claim kept on its own scale.

title: Sixth Lecture — GA 121. The Mission of Individual Folk-Souls in their Connection with Germanic-Norse Mythology
paraphrase: Six Elohim act from the Sun in Steiner’s account of solar and lunar cooperation.
interpretation_qualification: The larger lecture contains historically racist classifications. This relationship concerns the selected cosmological passages.

title: Sixth Lecture — GA 121. The Mission of Individual Folk-Souls in their Connection with Germanic-Norse Mythology
paraphrase: Jehovah is the Elohim who makes the Moon his sphere of activity as the other six act from the Sun.
interpretation_qualification: Jehovah belongs to the Spirits of Form, while GA 110 gives the Angeloi a Moon boundary.
